Bus Duct Meaning, Parts and Ratings in Brief

A bus duct (busway) is a prefabricated enclosure that carries copper or aluminium busbars to distribute large currents, typically from a transformer to the main LT panel or along a building or plant floor. It replaces multiple parallel runs of heavy cable.

Main Parts of a Bus Duct

  • Busbars: copper or aluminium conductors for R, Y, B and neutral.
  • Insulation: epoxy or sleeving, or air spacing in non sandwich types.
  • Enclosure: steel or aluminium housing, often used as the earth path.
  • Joints: bolted joint packs that connect sections.
  • Tap off units: plug in boxes with MCCB or fuse to feed loads along the run.

Typical Bus Duct Ratings

ParameterTypical range
Current rating400 A to 6300 A
VoltageUp to 1100 V for LT bus duct
Ingress protectionIP54 to IP65
Short circuit ratingUp to 100 kA for 1 s, as per design

Always confirm ratings on the maker data sheet and the type test certificate as per IEC 61439 6.
